subject: cannot evoke vline, where hline and point seem to work.

messages.author: 8c519738a4c17530
messages.subject: cannot evoke vline, where hline and point seem to work.
parts:
ggplot2 0.8.3 on R 2.9.1 on RHEL 5.3

I've got a graph

http://nersp.osg.ufl.edu/~asr/media/FIPRD.png

in which I have constrained the input for the prediction fits to a
subrange, because there's a pretty clear discontinuity in early 2008.

I would like to illustrate this with some unobtrusive hlines to mark
the edges of the considered range.


My data starts in a data.frame named series, with
> names(series)
[1] "amount" "date"

# I chop out the region of interest with, for example

firstRelevant = as.Date("2008-03-01");
relevant = series[series$date > firstRelevant,]

# and then I can

p + geom_point(colour="blue",data=relevant[relevant$date %in% range(relevant$date),])

easily enough, and get highlit points at the edges of the range of
interest (like in the png above). I can even

p + geom_hline(colour="blue",yintercept=relevant[relevant$date %in% range(relevant$date),]$amount)

and get horizontal lines through the points.
http://nersp.osg.ufl.edu/~asr/media/FIPRD-HLINE.png
but when I

p + geom_vline(colour="blue",xintercept=relevant[relevant$date %in% range(relevant$date),]$date)

I get nothing; no change in the graph from the just-points version.


What am I missing?



- Allen S. Rout

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: cannot evoke vline, where hline and point seem to work.
parts:
It's hard to know without a reproducible example, but I suspect it's
due to the complexities of the date time scale conversion. Try the
following and see if it works:

p + geom_vline(aes(xintercept = data), colour="blue",
data = subset(relevant, date %in% range(relevant$date))

Hadley

You can work around it with:

selected <- relevant[relevant$date %in% range(relevant$date),]
p + geom_vline(colour="blue",xintercept=as.numeric(selected$date))
